meta.name: higgsfield-generate
meta.description:
Generate images/videos/3D assets/audio via Higgsfield AI. Defaults:
GPT Image 2.5 for image/design/text, Seedance 2.5 for
video, Nano Banana 2 for cartoon characters, Marketing
Studio for ads, Seed Audio 1.0 for audio.
Use when: "generate an image", "make a video", "animate
this photo", "image-to-video", "edit/stylize/remix this
image", "reframe this video", "edit this video from a
sketch", "create a 3D model/GLB", "create a sound effect",
"make music", "text-to-audio", "create an ad", "make a UGC
video", "unboxing", "presenter video", "import product from
URL", or "analyze video virality". Supports generic generation,
workflows, Marketing Studio, and Virality Predictor.
Chain with higgsfield-soul-id for face/identity consistency.
NOT for: Soul training, brand systems/brandbooks (use
higgsfield-brandkit), photoshoots, cards, YouTube thumbnails
(use higgsfield-youtube-thumbnail), explainers (use
higgsfield-video-explainer), playable games/assets (use
higgsfield-websites), or TTS.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入一句话,就能生成图片、视频、3D 模型和音效,还能做广告和口播视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想快速拿到产品图、短视频或配音,却不想自己拍摄和剪辑。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a text prompt into images, videos, 3D models, or audio, and produce ads and UGC clips
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need ready visuals, videos, or audio without shooting or editing yourself.

howto.what: 你让它生成图片、视频、3D 模型或音频时,它会调用 Higgsfield CLI 提交任务并等结果,直接把媒体链接发给你;也能对成品视频给出钩子与传播力分析。
howto.when: 当你提到「生成一张图」「做个视频」「把这张照片动起来」这类请求,或要求分析成品视频的钩子与传播力时,由它接管。

say.text: 生成一张霓虹城市黄昏的图,16:9
say.note: 默认用 GPT Image 2.5 出图并给出链接

howto.what_en: When you ask for images, video, 3D models or audio, Claude submits jobs through the Higgsfield CLI and hands you the result links; it can also analyze a finished video's hook and virality.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to generate an image, make a video, animate a photo, or analyze a finished video's hook and virality.

say_en.text: Generate an image of a neon city at dusk, 16:9
say_en.note: Uses GPT Image 2.5 by default, returns the link
